question: Gwen's hair was twenty-eight centimeters long. After a haircut it was seventeen centimeters long. How much did she cut off?
Adam picked thirty-five strawberries. After eating some, he had thirty-three left. How many strawberries did Adam eat?
At the zoo a cage had sixty-eight snakes. If forty-two were hiding, how many snakes were not hiding?
A clown had eighty-two balloons. After a party he had sixteen left. How many balloons did he use at the party?
A pet store had eighty-five gerbils. If they sold sixty-nine of them, how many would they have left?
On Friday a pizza store sold 2 pepperoni, 6 bacon and 6 cheese pizzas. How many pizzas did they sell total?
In a game you start with 2 lives. If you got 6 extra lives in the first level and 11 more in the second, how many lives would you have?
A chef was making pies. He made 2 apple, 4 pecan and 7 pumpkin pies. How many pies did he make total?
A pet store had 2 white cats, 10 black cats and 3 gray cats. How many cats did they have total?
Paige had 2 pencils in her desk, 2 in her backpack and 15 at home. How many pencils does Paige have?
Jerry was weighing boxes for moving. The first was 2 pounds, the second was 11 pounds and the last was 5 pounds. What is the combined weight of all three boxes?
A chef bought 2 purple grapes and 2 green grapes. If he already had 3 grapes, how many grapes does he have now?
In the freezer there are 2 grape popsicles, 13 cherry popsicles and 2 banana popsicles. How many popsicles are there total?
A pet store had 2 dogs. On Sunday they got 5 more. On Monday they got 3 more. How many dogs does the pet store have now?
Tom already had 2 pieces of candy. His friend gave him 7 more and then Tom bought another 10. How many pieces does Tom have now?
A farmer planted 2 tomato seeds, 10 cucumber seeds and 3 pumpkin seeds. How many seeds did he plant all together?
Frank was reading a book. He read 2 pages at school, 3 on the bus and 3 at home. How many pages did Frank read?
Tom used 2 batteries on his flashlights, 15 in his toys and 2 in his controllers. How many batteries did Tom use?
For a new year's party 2 red balloons, 12 green balloons and 6 white balloons were used. What is the total number of balloons used?
A vet was weighing 3 cats. The first weighed 2 pounds. The second weighed 7 pounds and the last weighed 4 pounds. What is their combined weight?
Henry already had 5 dollars, but earned another 2 dollars doing chores. His friend had 13 dollars. If they put their money together, how much would they have?
Tom read 2 books in May, 6 in June and 10 in July. How many books did Tom read?
On a table there were 2 green apples, 3 red apples and 14 yellow apples. How many apples were on the table?
Henry was playing tic-tac-toe. He won 2 times, lost 2 times and it was a draw 10 times. How many times did Henry play?
An artist painted 2 pictures in June. He painted 2 more in July and in August he painted 9. How many pictures did he paint total?
